title: Reward-Instruct: A Reward-Centric Approach to Fast Photo-Realistic Image Generation

summary.en: Trains reward-enhanced few-step image generators from pretrained diffusion models using regularized reward maximization. Its reward-tilted parameter updates remove the need for a separate diffusion-distillation loss, studying the role of reward design in image quality and preference alignment.
summary.zh: 以带正则化的奖励最大化为核心，将预训练扩散模型转为少步图像生成器。方法通过奖励倾斜的参数更新进行训练，无需单独的扩散蒸馏损失，并研究奖励设计对视觉质量与偏好对齐的影响。
